goal: Test whether pretrained learning survives exact curve coordinates, then isolate shared depth-curve restrictions, conversion path and variable-depth training in small controlled models.
scope: This is an execution/training compatibility study. The toy depth field is an explicit experimental construction, not a claimed reproduction of the author's full GSA. No recurrent-memory replacement, permutation or neuron alignment.

pythia.trainable: All 72 parameter tensors in the six decoder blocks, 18,914,304 parameters. Embeddings, final normalization and output head remain fixed in every arm.
pythia.representation: Each original tensor independently flattened in native C order. Complete orthonormal Haar pyramid, stopping when the approximation length is odd. Every coefficient retained. Float64 master parameters/coefficients, float32 decoded network computation, explicit differentiable inverse transform.

optimizers.initial_state: Fresh and zero in every arm; this is controlled fine-tuning, not resumption of the pretraining optimizer.

pythia.transport_control: Backpropagate into the curve coefficients; map gradients to native coordinates; apply AdamW with native moments; map the updated float64 master weights back to coefficients. This is a control that preserves the native optimizer, not a proposed efficient curve optimizer.

training.batches: 24 fixed batches used once in identical order in every arm

pythia.data: Pinned Salesforce/wikitext wikitext-2-raw-v1, train split for 48 deterministic nonoverlapping blocks and validation split for 24 held-out blocks; exact selected token IDs saved. Not verified absent from Pythia pretraining.
metrics: Synthetic successor-copy accuracy and NLL on 24 fresh sequences
Paired parameter and output differences for SGD and transported Adam equivalence
First-step coefficient-gradient adjoint check and Adam update direction/norm comparison
pythia.limits: One checkpoint, one short data stream and fixed learning rates. No claim that one optimizer is generally better, that a full model was retrained, or that general capabilities/continual learning are established. Dense operators are still used on differentiably decoded weights.

toy.inputs: All 16 native-order vectors (a,b,c,d) in {-1,+1}^4, exhaustive finite functional coverage; not held-out generalization
toy.architecture: 4-to-16 tanh input, six native residual stages h <- h + tanh(W_l h + b_l)/6, six sigmoid/BCE outputs
toy.curve: W(s)=sum_j phi_j(s) C_j, b(s)=sum_j phi_j(s) d_j; phi_0=1/sqrt(6), phi_j=sqrt(2/6)*cos(pi*j*s). At s=(l+0.5)/6, all six modes form an orthonormal DCT-II basis across original layer identities. No within-layer coefficient truncation.
toy.depth_execution: At N steps, sample s=(i+0.5)/N and use h <- h + tanh(W(s)h+b(s))/N. This defines a controlled Euler discretization over depth [0,1].
toy.scratch_initialization: Shared random initial native weights per seed. Full curve conversion is exact. Restricted arms project that initialization to modes 0 and 1. Input/output parameters initially identical.
toy.optimizer: Adam lr 0.01, zero weight decay, full-batch float64. All scratch optimizers reset at step800 to match continuation controls.
toy.multidepth_training: Cycle N=3,6,12, one depth per step, with the same examples and number of optimizer steps. Average executed stages differ and are reported; no claim of equal compute.
toy.bridge: Keep the frozen discarded depth modes as an additive residual. Start at the exact teacher function; linearly reduce residual multiplier from 1 to 0 over the first 200 continuation steps. Train only the two retained modes plus input/output parameters. Final model matches the hard-conversion architecture.
metrics: Off-grid depth accuracy and logit drift from six steps
Fraction of native residual-parameter gradient outside the two-mode subspace
Parameter counts, step counts and runtime
toy.interpretation: Success from scratch with failed conversion is evidence of a transition issue on these tasks. Failure in both is not proof of a fundamental impossibility. Multi-depth performance must be separated from exact conversion at the original depth.

uncertainty: Pythia: 4000 paired bootstrap resamples over 24 held-out text blocks or 24 probe sequences; prose resampled by passage. Toy: retain and report every paired seed; five-seed ranges. No selection using held-out results; no hyperparameter search.
budget: 120 Pythia training steps total and at most 30,000 tiny toy steps. CPU only, bounded protocol, no broad architecture sweep.
